facts.rationale: Correct linear-lifecycle, ownership, recovery, and timer-reset oversimplifications.
facts.value: Start animation completion enters Hold and conditionally attempts item creation. Hold and Release share callback families. Their animation callback enters End directly when the fighter reference is absent and both post-update counters are nonpositive; otherwise it may select Release with the current frame. Owner mismatch only clears the reference and returns. Eligible B release clears fighter-side association/callbacks without directly changing motion or item ownership. End animation reloads counters and clears association every call; completed aerial End selects ordinary Fall for exact zero lag and the FallSpecial helper otherwise. Ground collision trigger interpretation is unresolved because current caller and enum-return callee polarities conflict.
